author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Instead of SDD (spec driven development) and TDD (test driven development) I invented a new xDD.

Introducing DDD - Dataflow Driven Development.

What is a software, it is just moving bits from A to B, transforming bits from X to Y, store some bits and restore them.   All three are just dataflow.   Once you nail down exactly how your dataflow should work, you can let AI take over writing the spec, the code and the test.
